Do you remember the first time you backed your car out of the driveway? That feeling is pure freedom. But for your parents, that moment was probably one of the scariest of their lives. When you were a teenager, they had no way of knowing if you were speeding, where you went, when you'd arrive, or how safely you were driving. "No news is good news" — they could only hope everything was okay until you checked in.

If you now have a teenager who drives, you should really cherish this moment, because you're no longer in the era of having to worry about it. Although technology in 2026 still has its imperfections, HeyPolo is clearly a great example of how technology can make teen driving safer and life better.

HeyPolo is more than just an upgraded version of Apple "Find My"

HeyPolo is a family safety app that bundles real-time location sharing, arrival and departure notifications, SOS emergency alerts, and driving safety features all into one price. The driving features are what set it apart from ordinary location-sharing apps (like Find My). Every time your child gets behind the wheel, their driving behaviour is tracked and scored, so you can clearly see how they're performing: how fast they drive, whether they use their phone while driving, whether they brake hard or accelerate suddenly, and whether any serious driving incidents are detected.

The "Driving Score" rates every trip based on their actual driving behaviour, so you no longer have to guess whether your child is really driving safely. You can look at the data, and if their driving performance isn't ideal, have a serious talk with them so they can improve their driving habits, and the score will naturally improve over time. Compared to anything the previous generation had access to, this is far more useful for helping newly licensed drivers build their skills.

Collision detection, arrival notifications, and more

HeyPolo can detect collisions and automatically notify you. Add to that arrival notifications — whether your child is going to school, practice, a friend's house, or home, the system will send triggered notifications — and you can move from "hoping no news is good news" to actually knowing whether they're safe. You don't have to wait until they arrive before messaging or calling them; you can clearly see when they've arrived, and that peace of mind is priceless for parents. HeyPolo updates location every 5 seconds, so your location information is always accurate.

One price, shared with the whole family

A single HeyPolo subscription already covers your entire family, with absolutely no extra per-person fees. It also supports both iPhone and Android, so there's no need to worry if family members use different devices. HeyPolo is built by the team behind Surfshark, so it has a solid privacy foundation. They won't sell your data; you control what you share, who you share it with, and when to stop sharing, with all data automatically deleted every 7 days. For a location-based app, this is absolutely essential when it comes to privacy.

HeyPolo offers a 30-day money-back guarantee, and there's no contract to sign — there's absolutely no reason not to give it a try.
